omarchy-audio-tuner on Omarchy

A measurement toolkit for building custom laptop-speaker EQ profiles on Linux.

To install omarchy-audio-tuner on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-audio-tuner. It is a 23.5 KB download (46.4 KB installed), version 0.1.0-1, licensed MIT. Tools for authoring Omarchy laptop speaker tunings. Free and open source (MIT licensed).

Install omarchy-audio-tuner on Omarchy

Omarchy Audio Tuner is a command-line toolkit for authoring speaker tuning profiles that restore the vendor sound signature Linux normally strips away on laptops. It walks through capturing microphone measurements, analyzing frequency response, fitting a correction curve, and generating a PipeWire filter chain, with A/B auditioning to check the result. It's explicitly for advanced users building a tuning for a laptop model Omarchy doesn't already cover — most people never need it.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-audio-tuner
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.0-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-audio-tuner

Open and use omarchy-audio-tuner

omarchy-audio-tuner has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql omarchy-audio-tuner | grep /usr/bin/

omarchy-audio-tuner requirements and compatibility

  • Python, FFmpeg, MPV, and LSP Plugins LV2 installed
  • A calibrated measurement microphone for building tunings from scratch (not required just to audition existing ones)

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • bash
  • python
  • ffmpeg
  • mpv
  • libpulse
  • lsp-plugins-lv2

Pricing and license

Free and open source (MIT licensed). License: MIT.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-audio-tuner on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-audio-tuner. The download is 23.5 KB and it takes 46.4 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-audio-tuner free?

Free and open source (MIT licensed). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-audio-tuner?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-audio-tuner. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-audio-tuner depend on?

The package declares 6 dependencies: bash, python, ffmpeg, mpv, libpulse, lsp-plugins-lv2. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-audio-tuner a desktop app?

No. omarchy-audio-tuner has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is omarchy-audio-tuner in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-audio-tuner (version 0.1.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom-io/omarchy-audio-tuner.
